sample_unit: patient-centred endodontic questions (each submitted 6 times per model)

links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM answers across repeated runs (length, semantic similarity, lexical distance)
links.effect: All models had stable response lengths across repeated runs; Gemini had the highest semantic consistency despite greater surface-level rewording.
links.quote: Gemini showed the highest semantic consistency despite greater surface-level rewording.

unlisted_practices: Examiner-stratified analysis of LLM clinical reliability ratings because inter-examiner agreement was poor

screen.reason: Evaluates the clinical reliability, safety, and reproducibility of multiple commercial LLMs on patient-centred endodontic questions without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
